title: Kairos --supply (static resolution bundle for external())
description: Input of the reference CLI's --supply: one entry per external() binding, keyed by the binding name or 'premise.binding' (the qualified key wins). The CLI checks only the shape; the supply contract (covering ⊇ points, ascending, real dates, kind match, label domain) is enforced by the evaluator (ADR-46). Unknown keys inside an entry are ignored. Published with kairos-lang 1.0.6 (1.0 addendum 23).

dates.description: kind: dates — civil days in the premise's tz (YYYY-MM-DD), ascending, no duplicates

instants.description: kind: instants — epoch milliseconds (the same convention as CliReport points), ascending, within ±8.64e15

covering.description: the completeness claim: 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD' (year-only ends allowed), '..' for all time, an open end for a concluded claim; several ranges separated by ', '

asof.description: version identifier of this data, compared by identity only (never ordered or parsed). Use the observation date YYYY-MM-DD unless your source has a better version id. Shown in annotations and the coverage summary; a mismatch with the premise's asof: is reported, not overridden

labels.description: optional parallel labels, one per point (kind: dates|instants with labels: declared)
